enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Lie still. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Move arm. Adjust blanket. Turn to left side. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket down. Remain still. Breathe slowly.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Take bowl from cabinet. Take spoon from drawer. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Put bowl in sink. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Look at watch. Bus arrives. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Turn on computer. Check emails. Review patient charts. Walk to examination room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Examine patient. Say 'How are you feeling today?' to patient. Write notes. Walk to nurse station. Discuss with colleague. Make phone call. Eat lunch. Attend meeting. Update records. Walk to patient room. Check vitals. Administer medication. Walk back to desk. Turn off computer.

Walk out of workplace. Say goodbye to colleague. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Insert card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Take plate to sink.
Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Sweep floor. Put away leftovers.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Lie on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Turn off lamp.
Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to back. Stretch. Remain still.
